| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 本库的 iOS 核心正在迁移到 Swift（[Swift-Migration.md](Swift-Migration.md)）。维护者已决定（2026-11-19 确认）：`CYLTabBarController`、`CYLPlusButton`、`CYLBaseNavigationController`、`CYLBaseViewController`、`CYLBaseTableViewController` 与 `CYLTabButtonBlockAnimation` 将成为 `open` 的 Swift 类。Swift 类不能在 Objective-C 中被继承，因此 App 中继承这些类的子类需要用 Swift 编写。本文说明为什么、要改什么、以及如何一步一步完成。 | The iOS core of this library is moving to Swift ([Swift-Migration.md](Swift-Migration.md)). The maintainer decided (confirmed 2026-11-19) that `CYLTabBarController`, `CYLPlusButton`, `CYLBaseNavigationController`, `CYLBaseViewController`, `CYLBaseTableViewController` and `CYLTabButtonBlockAnimation` become `open` Swift classes. A Swift class cannot be subclassed in Objective-C, so an app's subclasses of these classes must be written in Swift. This guide says why, what changes, and how to do it step by step. |

## [CN]状态
## [EN]Status

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| **进行中**：`CYLPlusButton` 自第 109 步起已是 Swift 类（尚未发布）；其余类目前仍是 Objective-C，现有的 Objective-C 子类照常工作。它们在迁移第 ② 阶段变为 Swift 类（[Swift-Migration.md](Swift-Migration.md)，"Plan"）；该版本发布时，本文与发布说明会写明版本号。现在就可以按下文把子类改写为 Swift：同样适用于当前的 Objective-C 类，切换时无需再改。 | **In progress**: `CYLPlusButton` is a Swift class since step 109 (not released yet); the other classes are still Objective-C today, and existing Objective-C subclasses of them keep working. They become Swift classes in phase ② of the migration ([Swift-Migration.md](Swift-Migration.md), "Plan"); the release that ships it will be named here and in the release notes. You can port your subclasses to Swift now, as below: they also work with today's Objective-C classes, so nothing changes again at the switch. |

## [CN]为什么
## [EN]Why

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| Swift 把类导出给 Objective-C 时带有 `objc_subclassing_restricted`：Objective-C 可以使用 Swift 类，但不能继承它。最终目标是 Swift Package Manager 中只有一个 Swift target（Objective-C 外壳无法放进去），因此保留 Objective-C 外壳类的方案被替换为 `open` 的 Swift 类。 | Swift exports its classes to Objective-C with `objc_subclassing_restricted`: Objective-C can use a Swift class but cannot subclass it. The goal is one Swift target in Swift Package Manager, which cannot hold Objective-C shell classes, so the earlier plan of thin Objective-C shells was replaced by `open` Swift classes. |
| 不变的部分：Objective-C 代码仍然可以创建、配置并调用这些类（所有方法保留原来的 selector）；只有"继承"需要 Swift。 | What does not change: Objective-C code can still create, configure and call these classes (every method keeps its selector); only subclassing needs Swift. |

## [CN]需要修改什么
## [EN]What to change

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 1. **找出子类**：在 App 中查找 `@interface … : CYLTabBarController`、`: CYLPlusButton`、`: CYLBaseNavigationController`、`: CYLBaseViewController`、`: CYLBaseTableViewController`、`: CYLTabButtonBlockAnimation`，以及这些子类的子类。 | 1. **Find the subclasses**: search the app for `@interface … : CYLTabBarController`, `: CYLPlusButton`, `: CYLBaseNavigationController`, `: CYLBaseViewController`, `: CYLBaseTableViewController`, `: CYLTabButtonBlockAnimation`, and for subclasses of those subclasses. |
| 2. **让 App 支持 Swift**：在 Objective-C 工程中添加第一个 Swift 文件时，Xcode 会询问是否创建桥接头文件（`<App>-Bridging-Header.h`），选择创建；在其中 `#import <CYLTabBarController/CYLTabBarController.h>`（CocoaPods / Carthage）或使用 `import CYLTabBarController`（Swift 文件中）。设置 `SWIFT_VERSION`（例如 5.0）。 | 2. **Add Swift to the app**: when you add the first Swift file to an Objective-C project, Xcode offers to create a bridging header (`<App>-Bridging-Header.h`); accept it and `#import <CYLTabBarController/CYLTabBarController.h>` there (CocoaPods / Carthage), or write `import CYLTabBarController` in the Swift files. Set `SWIFT_VERSION` (e.g. 5.0). |
| 3. **逐个改写子类**，保持类名：写成 `@objc(CYLHomeViewController) class CYLHomeViewController: CYLBaseTableViewController`。`@objc(名称)` 让 Objective-C 代码（以及 storyboard、`NSClassFromString`、配置文件中的类名）继续使用原来的名称。 | 3. **Port each subclass**, keeping its name: `@objc(CYLHomeViewController) class CYLHomeViewController: CYLBaseTableViewController`. `@objc(Name)` keeps the Objective-C name for Objective-C code, storyboards, `NSClassFromString` and class names in configuration files. |
| 4. **Objective-C 调用方导入生成的头文件**：使用这些子类的 `.m` 文件 `#import "<App模块名>-Swift.h"`，并删除旧的 `.h`。 | 4. **Objective-C callers import the generated header**: `.m` files that use the subclasses `#import "<AppModule>-Swift.h"`; delete the old `.h`. |
| 5. **PlusButton 的注册**：Objective-C 子类常在 `+load` 中调用 `[super registerPlusButton]`；Swift 没有 `+load`，请在创建 `CYLTabBarController` 之前显式调用 `CYLPlusButtonSubclass.register()`（例如在 `application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)` 或根控制器中）。 | 5. **Registering a plus button**: Objective-C subclasses often call `[super registerPlusButton]` in `+load`; Swift has no `+load`, so call `CYLPlusButtonSubclass.register()` explicitly before creating the `CYLTabBarController` (e.g. in `application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)` or the root view controller). |
| 6. **重写的方法**：`- (void)viewDidLoad` 变为 `override func viewDidLoad()`；`CYLPlusButtonSubclassing` 的类方法（`+plusButton`、`+indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`、`+plusChildViewController` 等）变为 `static func`（或 `class func`，若子类还要再重写）。 | 6. **Overridden methods**: `- (void)viewDidLoad` becomes `override func viewDidLoad()`; the class methods of `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing` (`+plusButton`, `+indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`, `+plusChildViewController`, …) become `static func` (or `class func` when a subclass overrides them again). |

| 7. **全局变量变为只读**（第 109 步起）：`CYLExternPlusButton`、`CYLPlusChildViewController` 与 `CYLPlusButtonWidth` 现在是 Swift 变量，Objective-C 通过宏读取；为它们赋值的代码不再能编译（它们只是库保存的值，读取不受影响）。 | 7. **The globals are read-only** (since step 109): `CYLExternPlusButton`, `CYLPlusChildViewController` and `CYLPlusButtonWidth` are Swift variables, read by Objective-C through macros; code that assigned them no longer compiles (they are values the library keeps; reading them is unaffected). |
| 8. **`+multiplerInCenterY`**（已废弃）现在是 `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing` 的可选方法，不再是 `CYLPlusButton` 的方法：Swift 子类实现它时去掉 `override`。 | 8. **`+multiplerInCenterY`** (deprecated) is now an optional method of `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing`, no longer a method of `CYLPlusButton`: a Swift subclass that implements it drops `override`. |

## [CN]示例
## [EN]Examples

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| Objective-C（迁移前）与 Swift（迁移后）的 TabBarController 子类： | A tab bar controller subclass in Objective-C (before) and Swift (after): |

```objc
// Before: MainTabBarController.h / .m
@interface MainTabBarController : CYLTabBarController
@end

@implementation MainTabBarController
- (void)viewDidLoad {
    [super viewDidLoad];
    self.delegate = self;
}
@end
```

```swift
// After: MainTabBarController.swift (Objective-C still sees it as MainTabBarController)
@objc(MainTabBarController)
final class MainTabBarController: CYLTabBarController {
    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        delegate = self
    }
}
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| PlusButton 子类（Swift）。在创建 TabBarController 之前调用一次 `CYLPlusButtonSubclass.register()`： | A plus button subclass in Swift. Call `CYLPlusButtonSubclass.register()` once before the tab bar controller is created: |

```swift
@objc(CYLPlusButtonSubclass)
class CYLPlusButtonSubclass: CYLPlusButton, CYLPlusButtonSubclassing {
    static func plusButton() -> Any {
        let button = CYLPlusButtonSubclass()
        button.setImage(UIImage(named: "post_normal"), for: .normal)
        button.sizeToFit()
        return button
    }

    static func indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar() -> UInt { 2 }
}
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 本仓库自己的 Objective-C 子类（Objective-C 示例的 `MainTabBarController`、`CYLFlatDesignMainTabBarController`、`CYLPlusButtonSubclass` 及其子类、首页 / 消息 / 我的 / 同城 / 详情控制器，库中的 `CYLConfigurationPlusButton`，测试中的 `CYLTestPlusButton`、`CYLSuperCallingTabBarController`）按本文的步骤逐个改写，可作为参考（Swift-Migration.md 第 107 步起）。 | This repository's own Objective-C subclasses (the Objective-C example's `MainTabBarController`, `CYLFlatDesignMainTabBarController`, `CYLPlusButtonSubclass` and its subclasses, the home / message / mine / same-city / details view controllers, the library's `CYLConfigurationPlusButton`, and the tests' `CYLTestPlusButton` and `CYLSuperCallingTabBarController`) are ported with these steps, one by one, and serve as references (Swift-Migration.md, from step 107). |
